benchmark.comparability_caveat: This executes the complete Harness paper-v3 eight-cell plan with one shared evolving scaffold. It uses the released RLinf policy without the unreleased Harness memory agent.

related_transfer_presets.claim_scope: Within-environment related-task transfer only; arbitrary disjoint task selections do not support this claim.

starting_agent.architecture: Frozen low-level policy exposed as one tool beside planner and perception tools

tools.blocker: This LIBERO route exposes no metric depth or camera calibration and has no Franka inverse-kinematics and trajectory executor for GraspGen poses.
